# CallAutomate

> Enterprise AI Voice Automation & Calling Operations Platform

CallAutomate provides intelligent 24/7 AI voice receptionists and automated agents for appointment booking, customer support, outbound sales, and after-hours call operations.

## Key Information
- Website: https://app.callautomate.ai/
- Platform: Enterprise Multi-Tenant AI Calling Operations
- Contact: support@callautomate.ai

## Core Features
- Appointment Booking: Automated scheduling synced to CRM.
- Customer Support: Instant FAQ resolution and ticket routing.
- Outbound Sales: Automated follow-ups and demo scheduling.
- After-Hours Calls: 24/7 continuous call answering and slot reservation.
